name: Twenty One Pilots
description: The self-released debut from Columbus, Ohio. Piano-driven, raw and introspective, it's where the story begins.
story: Psst! This is where it all started, back in 2009.
This album is like an open diary: questions about faith, doubt and purpose, mostly sung over a piano.
It's about feeling small and lost, but still holding on to hope. That idea never leaves their music.

name: Vessel
description: Their first major-label album. Clean, quiet greys, with the band's grandfathers on the cover.
story: Vessel! See the two men on the cover? They're Tyler's and Josh's grandfathers.
A vessel is a container. Many fans read it as the body: something fragile and temporary that carries who we are.
The songs wrestle with anxious thoughts and the fear of death, and choose to hold on to life anyway.

name: Blurryface
description: Named after a character who stands for insecurity. Red and black, with painted hands and necks.
story: Meet Blurryface. He isn't a real person: he's the name Tyler gave to his insecurities.
The black paint means something. On the neck: fear of what he says. On the hands: fear of what he creates.
The whole album is a fight against that voice. Giving your fears a name is the first step to beating them.

name: Trench
description: A concept album about escaping the walled city of Dema. Yellow tape, vultures and Banditos.
story: Welcome to Trench! This album built a whole world.
Dema is a walled city ruled by nine bishops. It stands for depression: a place that feels safe, but keeps you trapped.
Outside the walls live the Banditos, rebels who wear yellow, a colour the bishops can't see. Yellow means hope.
Trench is about the hard road out of that city, and finding the courage to keep going.

name: Scaled And Icy
description: Bright and pastel on the surface, written during lockdown. Blue dragons on a pink sky.
story: Scaled and Icy looks bright and happy: pastel colours, catchy songs, a blue dragon...
It was made during the pandemic, when life was scaled back and isolated. That's where the title comes from.
But mix up the letters and you get "Clancy is dead". Many fans see the album as a cheerful mask hiding something darker.

name: Clancy
description: The return to Dema's storyline, told from Clancy's point of view. Fire red and yellow.
story: Clancy is the hero who escaped Dema in Trench, and this album is told through his eyes.
It's about relapse and recovery: falling back into old habits, then choosing to fight again.
This time, Clancy doesn't just run away. He goes back to face the bishops.

name: Breach
description: The latest chapter. Dark rooms lit by a red glow, picking up where Clancy left off.
story: Breach is the final chapter of the story that began with Blurryface in 2015.
A breach is an opening in a wall. After ten years of trying to escape Dema, the walls finally give way.
It's a goodbye to a decade-long story, and a reminder of how far it has come.
